AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. Instance set on NAVCalculator via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances (each entry = ProtocolDataProvider address). Supersedes per-instance AaveV3_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

CompoundV3CometsMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Compound V3 comet. Supersedes per-instance CompoundV3_* adapters (removed from config 2026-11).

LidoStakedEthWalletMeta.$comment: Wallet-held yield tokens (ADR 0010 meta family). Each instance below is the yield TOKEN's own address, which is also a registered priced asset - that is what makes this value-neutral: the adapter reports balanceOf and NAVCalculator prices the asset it already priced, so only the identity changes. Reclassifies wstETH from `wallet`/`Wallet` to `lido`/`Staking`. ORDERING: the asset must be REGISTERED BEFORE it is claimed here - registerAsset refuses to arm the default adapter for an already-claimed token (MetaInstanceClaimedByAnotherAdapter), a hard revert rather than a silent double-count. The standard order (RegisterAssets, then 06_Configure) satisfies this.
